account: On 15 May 2025 software-engineering students from Karadeniz Technical University were presenting their Erken Uyarı Merkezi (Early Warning Center) to members of parliament. The report by the news agency DHA describes it as an AI-based earthquake early-warning system. The presentation took place in the Public Relations building of the Turkish parliament (TBMM) in Ankara. During it, a quake centered in Kulu, Konya, was felt in the capital. DHA gave the magnitude as 5.2. The U.S. Geological Survey lists M5.0 at 15:46 local time (12:46:37 UTC), 14 km east-north-east of Kulu at 10 km depth. Student Birkan Yılmaz said that notifications had reached their phones 30 seconds before the quake. Students, some members of parliament and building staff went outside. None of the cited reports mentions damage or injuries.

ai_role.statement: The system is called yapay zeka tabanlı (AI-based) in DHA's report, on the students' description. None of the read reports explains how it detects quakes, what data it uses, or whether the alert time was logged. The 30-second lead is the statement of student Birkan Yılmaz, a member of the team that built it. DHA carried it and Haberler, Yeni Akit and Yeni Çağ reproduced it. No MP, AFAD or Kandilli comment on the alert was found. Leaving the building was a human response to the notification and to the shaking.

fields.account: On 15 May 2025 software-engineering students from Karadeniz Technical University were presenting their Erken Uyarı Merkezi (Early Warning Center) to members of parliament. The report by the news agency DHA describes it as an AI-based earthquake early-warning system. The presentation took place in the Public Relations building of the Turkish parliament (TBMM) in Ankara. During it, a quake centered in Kulu, Konya, was felt in the capital. DHA gave the magnitude as 5.2. The U.S. Geological Survey lists M5.0 at 15:46 local time (12:46:37 UTC), 14 km east-north-east of Kulu at 10 km depth. Student Birkan Yılmaz said that notifications had reached their phones 30 seconds before the quake. Students, some members of parliament and building staff went outside. None of the cited reports mentions damage or injuries.

ratings.reason: According to a member of the team that built the app, the room got about 30 seconds of notice. Students, some members of parliament and building staff went outside. No damage or injury is reported, so the benefit is the notice itself.

revisions.change: Added the case from the OECD AI Incidents Monitor entry and the cited sources. All four readable sources carry the same DHA report, and the copies at ensonhaber.com and gercekgundem.com could not be read. The magnitude is given as DHA reports it (5.2) and as the U.S. Geological Survey lists it (M5.0 at 12:46:37 UTC, 10 km depth, 14 km east-north-east of Kulu). The system name Erken Uyarı Merkezi appears in the Yeni Çağ reports. No statement by Karadeniz Technical University, the Disaster and Emergency Management Authority (AFAD) or the parliament was found. Filed as a protective response with prevention unproven, because only the developer's statement in a DHA report documents the warning and no averted harm is documented.
